第27章 土耳其之旅-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

上一章

存书签

下一章

王建新站在巴统的海边，看着黑海对岸的方向。地图上显示，土耳其就在格鲁吉亚的南边，挨着的。来都来了，怎么也得去趟土耳其嘛。

他想了想，苏联这边该搞的东西都搞了，从莫斯科到巴统，跑了大半个国家，空间里塞得满满当当。但土耳其还没去过，那边是资本主义国家，跟苏联不一样，好东西肯定也不少。好像土耳其和苏联的关系不太好，边境管得严，但这对他不是问题。

“天黑了去看看吧。”

白天没事，王建新进了空间，开始整理零碎的东西。

首先是把贵重物品归置好。黄金、美金、卢布、各种钱币、珠宝饰品，从莫斯科银行金库里收来的那些，一直堆在平台上，乱糟糟的。他把这些东西一样一样地挑出来，拿回自己的书房。

书房在火车上，靠墙的书架旁边有一个铁皮柜子，是专门放贵重物品的。他把金条一块一块地码进去——大的像砖头，小的像手指，黄澄澄的，摞得整整齐齐。金币装在丝绒袋子里，一袋一袋地放好。美金、卢布、德国马克、法国法郎、英镑，分门别类地捆好，塞进柜子的抽屉里。珠宝首饰——项链、戒指、耳环、胸针，金的银的钻石的，装在原来的丝绒盒子里，摞在柜子最上面。

“这可是自己的财富啊。”王建新拍了拍柜子，心里美得很。

唯一可惜的是，为什么人民币他们不储备一些呢？

整理完贵重物品，王建新带上工具，领上大毛它们，开始种树、种菜。

从巴统植物园搞来的那些果树苗、茶树苗、浆果苗，还有之前从莫斯科植物园搞来的那些，全都堆在河边，根上带着土，用湿布包着，等着种下去。这次种植的东西可是不少。

他挑了一块地方——草坪区的东边，靠近河边，他留开间距，把所有的果树全部都种在这里。苹果树、梨树、桃树、杏树、樱桃树、李子树、柑橘树、柠檬树、柚子树、无花果树、石榴树、柿子树，一棵一棵地种下去，间距四五米，留够了生长的空间。

茶树种在果树旁边，一小片茶园，红茶、绿茶、乌龙茶、花果茶、黑莓茶，每样一小排。浆果种在茶园边上，草莓、覆盆子、黑莓、蓝莓，一垄一垄的。

种完了，王建新站在果树中间，看着一排排的小树，心里美滋滋的。

“给人一种感觉是农家乐的感觉。”他笑了笑。等这些树长大了，开花结果，空间里就更好看了。

种完了树，又把剩下的蔬菜苗也种了下去。西红柿、黄瓜、茄子、甜椒、豆角、秋葵、卷心菜、洋葱、大蒜、胡萝卜，一样一小块地，够自己吃就行。

忙活完所有的东西，天快黑了。王建新给自己又做了顿晚饭。从冰箱里拿出牛排煎了，配上红酒，又拌了个沙拉——生菜、西红柿、黄瓜，都是空间里自己种的，新鲜得很。吃了一顿舒舒服服的饭，把碗筷洗了。

天黑后，准备出发。

出发前，他先坐在河边修炼了一会，恢复一下精力。灵气在体内运转了几个大周天，精神饱满，浑身上下充满了力量。

这回他没开车，而是从空间里取出一辆自行车骑着。自行车是从莫斯科收来的，苏联产的，结实耐用。他骑着车，慢慢地向边境线靠近。

巴统到土耳其边境不远，十几公里。他骑了半个多小时，远远地就看见了边境线。那道边境线不是普通的铁丝网，而是一堵钢铁铸成的铁墙，高高的，厚厚的，把格鲁吉亚和土耳其彻底分割开了。铁墙上面有探照灯，来来回回地扫，墙下有巡逻的士兵，背着枪，来回走动。

“把守得很严密。”王建新远远地就下了自行车，把车收入空间，利用空间开始潜伏。

他贴着地面，利用空间挪移，几个闪烁便穿过了边境线。探照灯扫过来的时候，他已经在空间里了；灯扫过去了，他再出来，往前挪一段。炼气三层的空间挪移，十米范围内无视任何障碍物，穿过这道铁墙跟穿门帘似的。

穿过边境线，又往前跑了一段，出了巡逻士兵防守的区域，王建新才放慢脚步。他站在土耳其的土地上，看了看四周。

这边的景象跟苏联那边不一样。苏联那边是亚热带田园风光，这边是工业区，远处能看见工厂的烟囱，冒着白烟。空气里有股子化学品的味道。

他朝着城市里边跑去。这个城市不大，但工厂比较多。跑了将近一个小时，他来到了一大片工厂区。

Wang Jianxin stood on the beach in Batumi, looking in the direction across the Black Sea.The map shows that Türkiye is just south of Georgia, next to it.Even though I’m here, I still have to go to Türkiye.

He thought for a while and realized that everything that should be done on the Soviet Union's side had been done. From Moscow to Batumi, they had covered more than half of the country, and the space was packed to the brim.But I haven’t been to Türkiye yet. It’s a capitalist country. It’s different from the Soviet Union. There are definitely a lot of good things there.It seems that the relationship between Türkiye and the Soviet Union is not very good, and the border is strictly controlled, but this is not a problem for him.

"Let's go take a look when it gets dark."

Nothing was going on during the day, so Wang Jianxin entered the space and started sorting out the scattered things.

The first thing is to put your valuables away.Gold, U.S. dollars, rubles, various coins, and jewelry, collected from the vaults of the Moscow Bank, have been piled on the platform in a mess.He picked out these things one by one and took them back to his study.

The study room is on the train. There is a metal cabinet next to the bookshelf on the wall, which is specially used to store valuables.He piled the gold bars in one by one - big ones like bricks, small ones like fingers, yellow and neatly stacked.The gold coins were placed in velvet bags, one after another.U.S. dollars, rubles, German marks, French francs, and pounds were bundled into categories and stuffed into the drawers of the cabinet.Jewelry—necklaces, rings, earrings, brooches, gold, silver, and diamonds—are packed in the original velvet boxes and stacked on the top of the cabinet.

"This is my own wealth." Wang Jianxin patted the cabinet, feeling very happy.

The only pity is, why don’t they reserve some RMB?

After sorting out his valuables, Wang Jianxin took his tools, led Da Mao and the others, and started planting trees and vegetables.

The fruit saplings, tea saplings, and berry saplings obtained from the Batumi Botanical Garden, as well as those previously obtained from the Moscow Botanical Garden, were all piled by the river, with soil on their roots and wrapped in wet cloth, waiting to be planted.There are a lot of things planted this time.

He picked a place - the east side of the lawn area, close to the river. He left some distance between them and planted all the fruit trees here.Apple trees, pear trees, peach trees, apricot trees, cherry trees, plum trees, citrus trees, lemon trees, grapefruit trees, fig trees, pomegranate trees, and persimmon trees are planted one by one, spaced four or five meters apart, leaving enough room for growth.

The tea trees are planted next to the fruit trees, a small tea garden, black tea, green tea, oolong tea, flower and fruit tea, blackberry tea, each in a small row.Berries are planted on the edge of the tea garden, strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, and blueberries, ridge after ridge.

After planting, Wang Jianxin stood among the fruit trees, looking at the rows of small trees, feeling happy.

"It feels like a farmhouse." He smiled.When these trees grow up, bloom and bear fruit, the space will look better.

After planting the trees, I planted the remaining vegetable seedlings.Tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, bell peppers, beans, okra, cabbage, onions, garlic, carrots, all in a small piece of land, just enough for yourself.

After finishing all the work, it was getting dark.Wang Jianxin cooked himself another dinner.I took out the steak from the refrigerator and fried it, paired it with red wine, and mixed it with a salad - lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers, all grown in the space, very fresh.I had a nice meal and washed the dishes.

After dark, get ready to go.

Before setting off, he sat by the river and practiced for a while to regain his energy.The spiritual energy circulated in the body for several days, making him full of energy and full of strength.

This time he didn't drive, but took out a bicycle from the space and rode it.The bicycle was collected from Moscow, made in the Soviet Union, and is strong and durable.He rode his bike and slowly approached the border.

Batumi is not far from the Turkish border, more than ten kilometers.He rode for more than half an hour and saw the border line in the distance.That border line is not an ordinary barbed wire fence, but an iron wall made of steel. It is high and thick, completely dividing Georgia and Türkiye.There are searchlights on the iron wall, scanning back and forth, and there are patrolling soldiers under the wall, carrying guns on their backs, walking back and forth.

"It's very tightly guarded." Wang Jianxin got off his bicycle from a distance, put the bicycle into the space, and used the space to start lurking.

He stayed close to the ground, used the space to move, and crossed the border in a few flashes.When the searchlight swept over, he was already in the space; after the searchlight swept over, he came out again and moved forward.The space on the third floor of Qi Refining was moved, ignoring any obstacles within ten meters, and passing through this iron wall was like passing through a door curtain.

After crossing the border and running a little further, Wang Jianxin slowed down after leaving the area guarded by patrolling soldiers.He stood on Turkish soil and looked around.

The scene here is different from that in the Soviet Union.The Soviet side is a subtropical pastoral scenery, and this side is an industrial area. Factory chimneys can be seen in the distance, emitting white smoke.The air smelled of chemicals.

He ran towards the city.This city is not big, but it has many factories.After running for nearly an hour, he came to a large factory area.
